_comment: Where the research data in data/xref/, data/strongs/ and data/geo/ comes from. Used by tools/build-xref.mjs, build-strongs.mjs and build-geo.mjs. Sources that can't be pinned to a commit record the SHA-256 of the copy used; the build warns if it changes. Licences: see data/README.md.

xref._minVotesComment: OpenBible.info's readers vote on each reference; ones at zero or below were judged unhelpful and are left out.

strongs._comment: Open Scriptures' JSON edition of Strong's Hebrew (1894) and Greek (1890) dictionaries, pinned to a commit. CC BY-SA.
strongs._linkCorrectionsComment: Links in the Greek source that name the wrong entry, each checked against the word's etymology: Hebrew words written as G numbers (G25 ἀγαπάω: compare H5689 עָגַב, to love; G137 Αἰνών: H5869, a spring; G4460 Ῥαάβ: H7343), and typos for μέν (G3303) and ψυχή (G5590).

geo._comment: Places: OpenBible.info's Bible Geocoding Data (CC BY 4.0), pinned to a commit. Basemap: Natural Earth 1:10m land, lakes and rivers (public domain), clipped to the Bible lands and simplified.
geo._boundsComment: West, south, east, north (degrees): Rome to Persia, Asia Minor to Upper Egypt. Every map view must fit inside.
geo._detailComment: Simplification tolerance in degrees: finer inside detailBox (Israel and its neighbours), coarser elsewhere.
geo._lakesComment: Natural lakes only (modern reservoirs such as Lake Nasser are left out).
geo._riversComment: Natural Earth name → the name shown. Rivers the Bible names, plus the Tiber at Rome.
